jobs.title: Senior Manager - AI for Engineering Systems
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

As an Account Executive on our UK Public Sector team, you will own the Defence territory: selling the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to the Ministry of Defence, defence primes, system integrators, and allied national security organisations. This is a mission-driven, field-based role for someone who understands how data transforms Defence outcomes and can navigate the sensitivities of secure and sovereign environments.

**As an Account Executive you will:**

* Prospect, win, and onboard net-new Defence logos across the UK, breaking into MOD commands, defence primes, and strategic SIs that are not yet Snowflake customers
* Run complex, consultative sales cycles that align the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to mission priorities such as readiness, logistics, intelligence, and command and control
* Position Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, and secure data sharing for sovereign, air-gapped, and high-assurance workloads
* Partner with Solution Engineers to design architectures that meet Defence security, residency, and accreditation requirements
* Navigate UK public sector procurement, including G-Cloud, Digital Outcomes, and framework and direct-award routes
* Build trusted relationships with mission owners, programme leads, and procurement, from technical practitioners to senior leadership
* Collaborate with partners, resellers, and cleared delivery teams to land and expand mission-critical data programmes
* Forecast accurately and manage pipeline through the full sales cycle, from qualification to close and expansion

**Our Ideal Account Executive Will Have:**

* 5+ years of enterprise software, SaaS, or data platform sales experience, with consistent quota overachievement
* A proven track record selling into UK Defence
* Experience with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and long-horizon programme engagements
* Working knowledge of UK public sector procurement frameworks and the realities of secure or classified environments
* Fluency in articulating the value of data, analytics, and AI to mission outcomes
* Strong commercial discipline across territory planning, forecasting, and negotiation
* The ability to hold or obtain UK security clearance (SC or above) as required by the territory

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

* Experience selling cloud data platforms, data warehousing, or AI and machine learning solutions
* An existing network across MOD, defence primes, or allied agencies
* Familiarity with secure data sharing, data sovereignty, and high-assurance deployment patterns
* Experience working alongside system integrators and cleared delivery partners

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Optical Measurement Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Azure Fiber is looking for a Senior Optical Measurement Systems Engineer to join our Metrology team. You will apply fundamental science to develop advanced measurement capabilities for optical fibre products, with particular relevance to hollow-core fibre and, where applicable, fibre-cable characterisation.

In this role, you will own significant measurement-system challenges from first principles through deployment. You will use fundamental physics and measurement science to explain the underlying optical behaviour, define what must be measured and establish methods that are both scientifically rigorous and practically useful. You will connect theoretical modelling with bench-top characterisation, then translate successful methods into robust, automated and fully productionised test systems. You will create clarity in technically ambiguous areas, make data-driven engineering decisions, and influence partners across research, product engineering, manufacturing and quality.  
  
This is a hands-on laboratory role requiring regular on-site work in our state-of-the-art Romsey facilities. You will build, align, automate, troubleshoot and validate optical systems while helping others adopt rigorous measurement practices.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead the architecture, development and validation of optical measurement systems for fibre and related products, with emphasis on hollow-core fibre and occasionally cable-level measurements.
* Apply fundamental science—including optics, materials science and measurement physics—to identify observable signatures, derive measurement principles and develop new characterisation methods for complex fibre systems.
* Translate physical models and measurement theory into test requirements, measurement methods, uncertainty budgets, calibration strategies, traceability plans and acceptance criteria.
* Bridge early theoretical and bench-top characterisation work to repeatable production test solutions, including optical and electronic hardware, instrument control, automation software, data pipelines, fixtures, safety controls and maintainability.
* Design experiments and interpret observations relevant to fibre characterisation, including attenuation, mode coupling and modal content, polarisation effects, interference and other light–matter interactions.
* Establish and maintain measurement-system-analysis practices, including gauge repeatability and reproducibility studies, correlation studies, reference artefacts, calibration controls, statistical process control and capability assessment.
* Apply control-systems fundamentals to sensing, actuation, feedback, stabilisation and automation, improving the performance and robustness of laboratory and production equipment.
* Drive technical investigations and root-cause analysis across relevant areas; communicate decisions and risks clearly, influence cross-functional partners, mentor engineers and improve shared engineering standards.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Degree in Optical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.
* Understanding of optical-fibre characterisation, light-scattering and related optical phenomena, together with control-systems fundamentals and the ability to lead complex technical work across teams.
* Demonstrated ability to develop hands-on optical measurement or characterisation systems, including laboratory instrumentation, experiment design, automation and data analysis.

Other Requirements:

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role.
* These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  + Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in characterising optical fibres (hollow-core fibres would be a plus), fibre components or optical cable, using techniques such as cutback, OTDR or backscatter, modal, polarisation, interferometric or imaging measurements.
* Experience in converting research or prototype test methods into production equipment with appropriate throughput, reliability, serviceability, safety, data integrity and operational controls.
* Programming and test-automation experience using tools such as Python, C# or equivalent, including instrument communications, data pipelines, analysis and visualisation.
* Evidence of technical leadership at senior individual-contributor level: creating clarity in ambiguous problems, setting technical direction, influencing stakeholders, reviewing designs and mentoring other engineers.

jobs.title: NMS Modeling Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re champions of the North West and we’re proud that it’s our electricity network that connects communities and helps keep the electricity flowing every minute of every day, from when you wake up to when you fall asleep and all the hours in between.

A key part of the UK’s journey to net zero carbon is the revolution of our electricity industry to enable clean, green economic growth. As the North West’s electricity network operator, it’s our responsibility to lead the way, help the region decarbonise and pave the way for the growth of renewable energy and a sustainable energy future for all.

We’re proud that in December 2024 we were named Utility of the Year by Utility Week magazine who said we punched above our weight and used innovation to solve some of the industry’s most difficult challenges. Come and be part of our team and make a difference.

**Together we have the energy to transform our communities. We are switched on. We are adaptable. We take pride.**

**A Fantastic Opportunity: NMS Modelling Engineer**

The NMS Modelling engineer is responsible for ensuring that the Operational Network Diagram and any changes applied to it are fit for use and in line with Code of Practice for Operation and Network Automation. This role is key to enabling DSO transition and leveraging real-time systems to support business performance through the use of data and network performance metrics.

An accurate network model is key to enabling the functions of the Network Management System (NMS), including new capabilities aligned to Net Zero delivery such as Active Network Management (ANM) and flexible services. Through the performing of daily tasks including following reports and checking the networks performance metrics, you will be responsible for resolving Operation Network Diagram issues, to ensure that the system operates in an optimum fashion.

**What we're looking for:**

We’re looking for someone with a background in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline and a solid grasp of key concepts in power engineering and schematic diagrams. You’ll bring strong analytical skills, great attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a supportive team environment. We value people who consistently deliver accurate, reliable work, and we welcome applicants who also have knowledge of data models, data structures, Distribution Network Operators (DNOs), or Load Flow/Power Flow Analysisthough these are beneficial rather than essential. If you’re keen to grow, contribute, and develop your expertise in a dynamic engineering setting, we’d love to hear from you. A degree in electrical engineering or related field is required..

**What we're offering:**

As a vital team member and in return for your expertise, inclusive approach and commitment, we'll provide a favourable salary and the chance to join a passionate and welcoming team. We are committed to ensuring our people are supported and are proud of our reward and benefits offer, which includes:

* An annual bonus scheme
* 25 days annual leave increasing with length of service
* Private Healthcare
* Salary sacrifice car scheme
* An employee rewards portal offering discounts on several well-known brands
* A market-leading contributory pension scheme
* Employee assistance programme
* Opportunity for professional development through our L&D function.

Our people are important to us and we’re passionate about creating a great place to work where we can all be ourselves, reach our full potential and build long lasting careers. We’re striving to increase diversity of thought and talent in our people and to recruit highly skilled workforce that’s representative of the communities we serve. For us, embracing our differences is what makes us stronger.

Should you require any additional support with your application, or any adjustments please contact our Recruitment team at careers@enwl.co.uk or on 0845 366 0092 (option 2)

Any offer made will remain conditional until pre-employment checks are complete to a level deemed satisfactory by SP Electricity North West. Due to the of this role, the following pre-employment checks will be required; references from previous employers, Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) and a Drug & Alcohol test.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early.

*We don't accept speculative CVs from agencies. Any received we will assert ownership of the candidate and no fee will be payable.*
